international.title: Prince Harry tells Ukrainians they are ‘going to win war’ on surprise trip to Lviv
international.summary: Duke of Sussex meets wounded veterans in city and says country could one day host Invictus Games Prince Harry has told Ukrainian soldiers they are going to win the war with Russia, during a surprise visit to the country. The Duke of Sussex met wounded veterans and medics in the city of Lviv, in the west of Ukraine, as he addressed a conference on treating those injured in war. He said he had taken a risk in travelling to the country, but that he had felt “warmth” when arriving on Saturday. Continue reading...
